cards.ex: I won the first game, but it was just beginner's luck, I think.
cards.exUz: Men birinchi o'yinda g'alaba qozondim, lekin bu shunchaki yangi boshlaganlarga omad edi, deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Yangi boshlagan odamga birdaniga keladigan omad.

cards.ex: Finding that job was a real stroke of luck for him.
cards.exUz: U ishni topish uning uchun haqiqiy omad edi.

cards.ex: I didn't study; I'm just trusting to luck.
cards.exUz: Men o'qimadim; shunchaki omadga ishonib turibman.
cards.uzDef: Natija faqat omadga bog'liq deb o'ylamoq.

cards.ex: I met her by chance at the library.
cards.exUz: Men uni kutubxonada tasodifan uchratib qoldim.

cards.ex: Their relationship started with a chance encounter at a conference.
cards.exUz: Ularning munosabatlari konferentsiyada tasodifiy uchrashuvdan boshlandi.

cards.ex: We can't leave the success of the project to chance.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihaning muvaffaqiyatini omadga topshira olmaymiz.

cards.ex: I hoped for a promotion, but no such luck.
cards.exUz: Men lavozim ko'tarilishini umid qilgandim, lekin omad yo'q.

cards.ex: He's been down on his luck since losing his job.
cards.exUz: U ishini yo'qotganidan beri omadsiz bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaqtda omadsiz, muammolarga duch kelgan.

cards.ex: We're having a pot luck dinner; bring whatever you want.
cards.exUz: Bizda "nima bo'lsa" kechki ovqat bo'ladi; xohlaganingizni olib keling.
cards.uzDef: Mehmonlar nima olib kelsa, shuni yeyish.

cards.ex: As luck would have it, I found my keys right before leaving.
cards.exUz: Omad keltirganidek, ketishdan oldin kalitlarimni topdim.

cards.ex: You've won a lot already; don't push your luck.
cards.exUz: Siz allaqachon ko'p yutdingiz; omadingizni sinamang.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lish xavfini oshirmoq.

cards.ex: It was pure chance that we met again after all these years.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillardan keyin yana uchrashganimiz sof tasodif edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday reja yoki sababsiz yuzaga kelgan narsa.

cards.ex: The odds are that it will rain tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ehtimol, ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi.

cards.ex: There's a slim chance of winning the lottery.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada yutishning imkoniyati juda kam.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam imkoniyat, deyarli yo'q imkoniyat.

cards.ex: He won the competition by a fluke.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada tasodifan g'alaba qozondi.

cards.ex: His fatal flaw was his inability to listen to others.
cards.exUz: Uning halokatli kamchiligi boshqalarni tinglay olmasligi edi.

cards.ex: We decided to roll the dice and invest in the startup.
cards.exUz: Biz tavakkal qilib, startapga sarmoya kiritishga qaror qildik.

cards.ex: They were supposed to meet, but fate intervened, and they never saw each other again.
cards.exUz: Ular uchrashishi kerak edi, lekin taqdir aralashdi va ular hech qachon bir-birlarini ko'rishmadi.

cards.ex: They decided to gamble on a new marketing strategy.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi marketing strategiyasiga tavakkal qilishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Natija noma'lum bo'lgan narsaga pul yoki resurslarni tikmoq.

cards.ex: She hit the jackpot when she invested in that company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritganda omadi kuldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdorda pul yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: Lightning strikes twice! He won again!
cards.exUz: Omad yana keldi! U yana g'alaba qozondi!

cards.ex: You have to take your chances if you want to succeed.
cards.exUz: Agar muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, imkoniyatdan foydalanishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Noma'lum natijaga qaramay, xavfni o'z zimmangizga olmoq.

cards.ex: It's a long shot, but it's worth trying.
cards.exUz: Bu kam umidli, lekin urinishga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli juda kam bo'lgan harakat.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves a fair shake in life.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson hayotda adolatli munosabatga loyiq.

cards.ex: It's like winning the lottery! I can't believe I got the job.
cards.exUz: Bu lotereyada yutgandek! Ishga qabul qilinganimga ishonmayman.

cards.ex: You didn't win, but better luck next time.
cards.exUz: Siz yutmadingiz, lekin keyingi safar omad.

cards.ex: I'll chance my arm and ask for a raise.
cards.exUz: Men tavakkal qilib, oylikni oshirishni so'rayman.

cards.ex: Despite the difficulties, she came up trumps and finished the project on time.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u omadli bo'ldi va loyihani o'z vaqtida yakunladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatda muvaffaqiyatli chiqmoq, yaxshi natija ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: Everything will fall into place eventually.
cards.exUz: Vaqt o'tishi bilan hamma narsa o'z o'rniga tushadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan muammosiz sodir bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Lady Luck was on our side tonight.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun omad biz tomonda edi.
